mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cs_session WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM cs_session WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
SELECT * FROM cs_session WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM cs_session WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND last_active_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_session (session_no, customer_id, agent_id, skill_group_id, status, vip_level, queue_start_at, last_active_at, metadata) VALUES (#{sessionNo}, #{customerId}, #{agentId}, #{skillGroupId}, #{status}, #{vipLevel}, #{queueStartAt}, #{lastActiveAt}, #{metadata})
mapper.update: UPDATE cs_session SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cs_session SET last_active_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
